card.name: Foreign-language titles in citations
card.fires_on: Words inside non-English book titles or names (German, Latin, French, Spanish, Slovene, Russian) quoted in historical or reference text. It fires on small linking words like des, aux, los, or partway through a long word.

modes.label: Linking words in titles
modes.description: Small words like des, aux, los inside a foreign-language title.

modes.label: Partway through foreign words
modes.description: Middle pieces of long foreign names or terms, often Latin or Russian.

card.writes: It promotes Russian word endings like -ения and -ания, which suggests it expects a Russian word to be completed.
card.plain: It lights up inside foreign-language book titles and names, especially on little joining words or the middle of long words.
